title: Zynpath: Number Path Puzzle
shortDescription: One path. Every number. Connect checkpoints and cover the whole board!
fullDescription:
Welcome to Zynpath: Number Path Puzzle — the ultimate logic challenge where every cell matters!

One path. Every number.
Can you draw a single, uninterrupted line that connects every checkpoint in ascending order and fills every required cell on the grid?

■ HOW TO PLAY
1. Start at Checkpoint 1: Every puzzle begins from number 1.
2. Ascending Checkpoints: Connect checkpoints in strictly sequential order (1 → 2 → 3 → ... → N). No skipping numbers!
3. Strictly Orthogonal: Move horizontally or vertically into adjacent cells. Diagonal shortcuts are never allowed.
4. Full Grid Coverage: 100% of required board cells must be covered. Reaching the final number is NOT enough if empty cells remain.
5. Navigate Walls: Crimson wall barriers block specific cell edges. Route through corridors around them!
6. Free Undo & Reset: Made a wrong turn? Undo individual steps or reset the board at any time without penalty.

■ 6 CANONICAL WORLDS • 300 OFFLINE LEVELS
Embark on a crafted campaign across 6 distinct worlds:
• World 1: The Awakening (4x4 grids, gentle introduction)
• World 2: Binary Drift (5x5 grids, longer connections)
• World 3: Labyrinth of Walls (5x5 grids, interior barrier corridors)
• World 4: Quantum Portal (6x6 grids, intricate labyrinths)
• World 5: Temporal Flux (7x7 grids, complex multi-checkpoint paths)
• World 6: The Singularity (8x8 grids, 100 expert mastery challenges)

Every level is 100% offline-ready. Play anytime, anywhere—on planes, subways, or offline retreats.

■ DAILY CHALLENGE
Participate in a brand-new, globally synchronized puzzle every 24 hours at 00:00 UTC!
• Build and protect your daily streak across consecutive UTC dates.
• Compete on the official Daily Leaderboard with server-verified solve times.
• Complete offline and sync your participation when you reconnect.

■ REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER MODES
Put your pathfinding skills to the test with real-time puzzle racing:
• Quick Duel: Instant 1v1 matchmaking on identical solver-verified puzzles. First player to complete dual-win coverage wins!
• Friend Duel: Challenge friends directly with private 6-character room codes and interactive rematches.
• Mini League: Host or join private 2–5 player party rooms with live progress tracking and podium finishes.

■ GUEST-FIRST & PRIVACY-AWARE
• Start playing immediately upon install—zero mandatory sign-in or account creation.
• Optional account linking with Google or Facebook preserves all local progress.
• Your puzzle trajectories, touch coordinates, and solve paths remain 100% private on your device.

■ OPTIONAL PREMIUM & FAIR PLAY
Enhance your aesthetic experience with Zynpath Premium:
• Exclusive cosmetic themes (Midnight Glass, Neon Cyber, Papercraft).
• Custom path particle trails and avatar frames.
• Advanced personal solve-speed distributions and backtracking analytics.
• 100% Fair Play Guarantee: Premium NEVER alters puzzle difficulty, hint allowances in competitive duels, or timer conditions. Skill and logic determine every victory.

Download Zynpath today and experience pure continuous-path logic puzzle mastery!
